items.title_orig: Green River (a band from Seattle) turned into Mudhoney, Pearl Jam, Temple of the Dog, Mother Love Bone and Love Battery.
items.article_text:
Not having Marcus acknowledge the existence of a band that all grew up together there and named their band after a local active serial killer that turned into several subsequent bands sortable from respectable to epic is driving me bonkers.
 Their 1988 “Rehab Doll” was the 15th record released by Sub Pop.
 The 1990 reissue of that with their new EP “Dry as a Bone” is the one to look for on streaming platforms.
 Groovy stuff, worth tracking down. Make a solid No Dogs episode.
 For fans of the label it’s foundational. Enjoy, friends

items.title_orig: Its never too early for 2027 line up speculations/hopefuls/guesses
items.article_text:
This was my 2nd time at RW, the first time was 2023 which, for me personally, was the best line up ever (it included 4 of my top 5 favourite artists). Went back to Lowlands in 24 and 25 and this year at RW just proved once again that RW is sooooo much better (for plenty of reasons).
 That being said I’m already looking forward to next year and the line up announcement. 
 Drop your guesses/wishes for 2027 below 👇** **
 For me its:
 Pearl Jam
 Kings of Leon
 QOTSA
 The 1975
 Editors
 Turnstile
 Idles
 The Neighbourhood
 Radiohead
 Massive Attack
 Foals
 Royal Blood
 I’m aware some of these might be very unlikely to go on tour next year but these are some artists I love seeing live or have been waiting to see live for the first time
